widget.prompt: Start at 34 and count on 4. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 5 hops. Count just 4 from 34 to land on 38.

predict.prompt: Counting on 4 from 34 — will you pass 40?
predict.reveal: 34 count on 4 reaches 38. 4 falls short of the 6 needed to reach 40 — the count stops just before the ten.
